items.title: Iran threatens to block more trade routes as US launches fresh strikes
items.description: US President Donald Trump vowed to strike Iran's bridges and power plants next week if the country does not return to talks.

items.title: Trump retreat over Hormuz tolls suggests he is struggling to end Iran war
items.description: The abrupt about-face from the US president was the latest twist in a conflict that has now lasted more than four months.

items.title: Strait of Hormuz 'faultline' exposes weakness of the US-Iran deal
items.description: Control of the waterway has become a key point of contention between the US and Iran, as a ceasefire deal falters.

items.title: Three killed as Russian bombing of Odesa continues
items.description: In recent days, Russia and Ukraine have launched attacks on each others' infrastructure for shipping goods.

items.title: Italy's Meloni suffers surprise setback in close vote on electoral reform
items.description: The defeat triggered opposition calls for Meloni to resign ahead of next year's general election.

items.title: Kenyan court dismisses Rastafarians' bid to legalise cannabis
items.description: The court acknowledged the need for a broader national debate on cannabis policy in Kenya.

items.title: Air India crash report likely to be ready in October, say investigators
items.description: The crash killed 260 people, including 241 on board, with only one passenger surviving.
